recommendation.reason: Real production kernels, executable correctness/speed scoring, and human review support recommendation; the new-benchmark waiver covers unquantified difficulty and attention.
risks: Full coverage needs Arm Graviton3/Graviton4 and Apple M4 hardware.
M4 runs require a manually allocated AWS Dedicated Host.

release.quote: The tasks live in the Hugging Face dataset [`l3lab/KernelShift`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/l3lab/KernelShift).

rights.data_license: BSD-3-Clause (for `loops/` and `dataset/problems/`; HF dataset license not stated)

verifier.entry_point: python -m bench.cli bench --definition loop_001 --solution reference-scalar_loop_001 --dataset simd-loop --isa sve
verifier.full_credit: A kernel scores only if it is correct on every workload, and its score is the speedup over the expert implementation.
